notes.title: ECLIPSE HORDE HALLOWEEN UPDATE!!
notes.notes:
Alpha 2.3.2 RELEASE NOTE (2021-10-27)
　Even if you update from 2.1.*, you can use the save data as it is. There is no need for NEW GAME.

Added
- Halloween items have been added.
-- PUMPKIN HAMMER
-- PUMPKIN BACKPACK
-- SHEET GHOST
- Added punch attack motion for human NPCs.

Changed
- The help button now shows a red arrow when you start the game for the first time.

Fixed
- Fixed an issue where only rubber boots could be caught in fishing.
- Fixed an issue where scrapping an item in a container would cause a mysterious apple to appear on the - tool belt.
- Fixed an issue where human NPCs did not counterattack players.
- Fixed an issue where human NPCs were destroying blocks at high speed.


https://main-ezorisudo.ssl-lolipop.jp/eh/e.html
